title: 点阵图两次降息：Dutta还要加多次，市场预期被颠覆？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: No doubt of Renmack joins us now for more. No good afternoon, buddy. Good to see you.
segments.zh: Renaissance Macro Research加入我们。下午好，很高兴见到你。

segments.en: 25 basis points. I assume you do think there's more to go. Yeah, I do. I mean, I think there's certainly more to go.
segments.zh: 25个基点。我想你认为还有更多。是的，我认为肯定还有更多。

segments.en: I'm a little skeptical that it's just going to be one more.
segments.zh: 我有点怀疑只会再加一次。

segments.en: I think the Fed will end up delivering more than that. But if you look at their forecast revisions,
segments.zh: 我认为美联储最终会加更多。但如果你看他们的预测修正，

segments.en: I mean, what do people really expect? I mean, the unemployment rate was revised down.
segments.zh: 人们真正预期什么？失业率被下修了。

segments.en: Core inflation was revised up. I mean, to the extent that they raised their longer run estimate, that means they're kind of moving the policy rate in tandem with that.
segments.zh: 核心通胀被上修。他们提高了长期估计，这意味着政策利率也在同步调整。

segments.en: So the overall level of the policy stance, restrictive, accommodative, doesn't really change.
segments.zh: 所以政策立场的总体水平，限制性或宽松性，并没有真正改变。

segments.en: And I think the bigger question that markets need to deal with here is, do you actually need to cool the economy down to get inflation to 2 percent?
segments.zh: 我认为市场需要应对的更大问题是，你真的需要冷却经济才能让通胀达到2%吗？

segments.en: There's a lot of people that don't seem to think that.
segments.zh: 很多人似乎不这么认为。

segments.en: And I don't know. And so that's kind of where I'm at right now.
segments.zh: 我也不知道。这就是我目前的看法。

segments.en: I mean, I think a lot of the sort of one and done kind of discussion that we saw going into this is really just, it's sort of like the nature of the sales side, right?
segments.zh: 我的意思是，之前那种一次就结束的讨论，其实只是卖方机构的常态，对吧？

segments.en: Like a few weeks ago, no one even thought that they would hike in September. Some people thought the next move would be a cut, right?
segments.zh: 几周前，甚至没人认为他们会在九月加息。有些人还觉得下一步会是降息，对吧？

segments.en: So you kind of have to mark to market your forecast, and now you have to start to think a little bit about where we're going to go over the next three to six months.
segments.zh: 所以你得根据市场变化调整预测，现在必须开始考虑未来三到六个月会怎么走。
